name: AH 6181
title: Experiential Learning in Health Promotion Research
description: Mentored research experiences on and/or off-campus to increase doctoral student's breadth and depth of knowledge, skills and competence in health promotion science. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: AH 6324; a graduate statistics course; instructor consent required; open only to doctoral students after first semester of doctoral work.
